instruction: Clone /dev/sda to /dev/sdb block-by-block with 4MiB blocks
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=4M status=progress

instruction: Clone sda to sdb with error handling: skip bad blocks, no truncation, sync I/O
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=64K conv=sync,noerror conv=notrunc iflag=fullblock status=progress

instruction: Clone first 1GB of sda to a disk image
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img bs=1M count=1024 status=progress

instruction: Write a raw disk image back to sdb using direct I/O
output: dd if=disk.img of=/dev/sdb bs=1M oflag=direct status=progress

instruction: Skip 2048 sectors on input and output, copy 1000 sectors
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=512 skip=2048 seek=2048 count=1000 status=none

instruction: Zero-fill remaining space on a partition using /dev/zero
output: dd if=/dev/zero of=zerofile bs=1M status=progress; sync; rm zerofile

instruction: Use direct + sync flags for safest possible block copy
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=1M iflag=direct,fullblock oflag=direct,sync status=progress

instruction: Exclude specific partition from clone by skipping its sectors
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=512 skip=2048 seek=2048 count=1000000 status=progress

instruction: Create a sparse-aware image clone preserving holes
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img bs=1M conv=sparse status=progress

instruction: Clone without showing transfer statistics
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=4M status=none

instruction: Read from a broken drive using sync iflag, write with fdatasync
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=512 iflag=sync oflag=dsync conv=noerror status=progress

instruction: Print dd version and confirm installed tool
output: dd --version

instruction: Copy only new data since a previous clone using seek and skip offsets
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=incremental.img bs=1M skip=1024 seek=1024 count=512 status=progress

instruction: Clone a partition to a compressed image through a pipe
output: dd if=/dev/sda1 bs=1M status=progress | gzip -c > sda1.img.gz

instruction: Restore compressed image back to partition
output: gunzip -c sda1.img.gz | dd of=/dev/sda1 bs=1M status=progress

instruction: Show dd help and all available flags
output: dd --help

instruction: Clone failing drive skipping errors with no xfer progress output
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=512 conv=noerror conv=sync iflag=fullblock status=noxfer

instruction: Clone using 128K buffer and direct I/O on output only
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=128K oflag=direct status=progress

instruction: Copy last 500MB of a drive using skip and count with exact byte offset
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=tail.img bs=1M skip=$(($(blockdev --getsz /dev/sda) / 2048 - 500)) status=progress

instruction: Use dd to wipe MBR sector
output: dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=446 count=1 status=progress

instruction: Write a pattern to the entire drive with dd
output: dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdb bs=1M status=progress

instruction: Clone with conv=excl to fail if output file exists
output: dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb bs=4M conv=excl status=progress
